criteria.title: Observation, requirement, and UX interpretation are distinct
criteria.description: The candidate separates objective browser facts, measurement, binding requirement decisions, and semantic UX judgment, with evidence that supports each claim.

criteria.title: Browser ownership and safety are preserved
criteria.description: The candidate respects existing Playwright ownership, serial operation, side-effect scope, secret handling, cleanup, and no-progress.

criteria.title: Scope, applicability, and evidence are accurate
criteria.description: The candidate closes only the declared live Web scope, uses the right evidence type, and does not invent user goals, personas, rules, or missing observations.

criteria.title: Routing and result boundaries are preserved
criteria.description: Evaluate only the routing boundary exercised by the case: detailed TC execution to its owner, formal WCAG conformance to wcag-conformance-evaluation, general live inspection within usability-inspection, or static evidence review to usability-evaluation. Do not require unrelated routing paths that the request does not exercise. Do not claim page/product conformance.
